name: Telekinetic Charge (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School transmutation; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, psychic 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You launch yourself, empowered with telekinetic force toward a target. The target must be within 4 times your base speed and you must have a line of effect on the target. You rapidly shift to adjacent to the target and make a melee attack that grants you the benefits and penalties of a charge. You double the attack bonus from your charge in this instance. You do not provoke any attacks of opportunities for this movement.

You can instead perform a bull rush at the end of the charge with a bonus to the bull rush attempt equal to your caster level.
